segments.name: Service
segments.description: Provides accredited calibration and related services plus asset management solutions to highly regulated industries, particularly life sciences.
segments.evidence: Through our Service segment, we offer calibration, repair, inspection, analytical qualifications, preventative maintenance, consulting and other related services, a majority of which are processed through our proprietary asset management system, CalTrak® and our online customer portal, C3®.

segments.name: Distribution
segments.description: Sells and rents new and used national brand test and measurement instruments globally, with value-added calibration services.
segments.evidence: Through our Distribution segment, we sell and rent national brand instruments to customers globally.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for calibration and related services and for the sale and rental of test and measurement instruments.
revenueModel.evidence: Most instruments we sell and rent require calibration service to ensure that they maintain the most precise measurements.

changes.text: In fiscal 2026 the Company acquired Essco Calibration Laboratory, expanding its calibration service portfolio.
changes.evidence: Effective August 5, 2025, the Company acquired Essco, a privately-held calibration services corporation located in the Boston Metro area that is ISO 17025 certified.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the Company acquired Martin Calibration and Becnel Rental Tools.
changes.evidence: Effective December 10, 2024, the Company acquired Martin, a privately-held Minnesota-based Midwest regional calibration services company.
